definition: Aboveground live biomass carbon predicted by the model. The dashboard converts this carbon value to CO2e by multiplying by 3.667.
American Carbon Registry; one of the carbon accounting protocols supported by the dashboard.
The annual change in aboveground live biomass carbon between modeled years.
Year-by-year carbon dioxide equivalent estimate shown for selected protocols after carbon-unit calculations.
The assumed annual inflation rate applied to project costs over time.
The base web address used by the dashboard or client package to call the model service API.
Basal area; the cross-sectional area of trees, generally expressed in square feet per acre in forestry outputs.
The cross-sectional area of trees in a stand. In the dashboard it may be shown per acre or scaled to the full project.
The number of project acres needed for the selected scenario to reach the target NPV, usually $0.
The tree density or density range needed for the selected scenario to reach the target NPV.
A share of credited carbon set aside to manage reversal or project risk under a protocol.
Climate Action Reserve; one of the carbon accounting protocols supported by the dashboard.
A modeled estimate of carbon storage or CO2e for a planting scenario before or after protocol adjustments depending on the chart context.
A carbon accounting framework or registry rule set used to estimate creditable carbon and related financial outcomes.
API output records containing modeled carbon values by year, commonly including Year, ABLD_C, and Annual_ABLD_C.
Protocol-adjusted carbon values calculated from modeled carbon rows and selected protocol rules.
Continuous Forest Inventory plot used for monitoring or verification cost calculations.
Carbon dioxide equivalent; carbon expressed as equivalent carbon dioxide. In Planting Parameters, modeled CO2e is calculated from ABLD_C times 3.667 before protocol adjustments.
The backup modeling path used when FVS model files are not available; it estimates carbon from configured coefficients.
The assumed cost for each continuous forest inventory plot used in verification cost estimates.
The assumed starting market price per carbon credit or carbon unit used in revenue calculations.
also_known_as: Price per CO2e; price per ERT

definition: The assumed annual increase in the carbon credit price.
The period over which a project is assumed to generate carbon credits or carbon-unit revenues.
Carbon units returned by the carbon-unit calculation. These values are protocol-adjusted and are used in carbon estimates and financial calculations.
CO2e accumulated over time. In protocol charts this is the cumulative sum of protocol-adjusted annual carbon units.
The rate used to discount future cash flows to present-day value in NPV calculations.
Emission Reduction Ton or similar credit unit used by some protocols and financial assumptions.
Frequently Asked Questions page containing longer explanations and methodological notes.
Forest Vegetation Simulator; a forest growth model used as the basis for training or generating dashboard growth and carbon estimates.
A trained model or model output based on FVS simulations for a selected variant, location, and planting scenario.
An FVS model variant calibrated for a particular geographic region.
A location within an FVS variant, often representing a National Forest, district, or other regional calibration area.
A carbon standard supported by the dashboard, shown as GS in protocol selections.
Gold Standard; one of the carbon accounting protocols supported by the dashboard.
A carbon protocol or registry represented as ISO in this dashboard.
A per-credit or per-unit fee applied when carbon credits are issued.
Biomass equations used by the dashboard to estimate biomass-based carbon consistently across supported protocols.
Emissions or carbon impacts outside the project boundary that may be deducted under protocol accounting rules.
The FVS variant location code used by the dashboard and API to identify the selected location.
Merchantable cubic volume predicted by FVS-based outputs.
Tree volume considered merchantable under model definitions, shown as MCuFt in some outputs.
Indicates whether results came from FVS-based models or the coefficient fallback path.
The Planting Parameters CO2e chart value. It is calculated from modeled aboveground live biomass carbon before protocol-specific deductions or adjustments.
The number of acres enrolled or modeled for the project. Total Project displays scale per-acre values by this acreage.
The present-day value of projected net revenues after discounting future cash flows.
Net Present Value; the present-day value of projected net revenues after discounting future cash flows.
Net Present Value divided by project acres.
The year through which cash flows are discounted for the reported NPV value.
Pre-commercial thinning; removal of young trees before they are merchantable to influence stand density and growth.
Display mode showing values on a per-acre basis rather than scaled to the full project acreage.
Upfront planting cost, including items such as site preparation and labor depending on assumptions.
The Planting Design section where users choose survival, site index, species mix, TPA, and related design inputs.
A thinning treatment applied before trees are merchantable, used to manage stand density and future growth.
The assumed starting price for each carbon credit or carbon dioxide equivalent unit used in revenue calculations.
API output records containing year-by-year financial calculations used to produce project summaries.
The dashboard section estimating project revenues, costs, total net revenue, and NPV from selected carbon estimates and financial assumptions.
CO2e after selected protocol rules, coefficients, buffers, leakage, or other adjustments have been applied.
Quadratic mean diameter; a stand-level average tree diameter metric predicted by FVS-based outputs.
Fixed or recurring fees associated with registering a project or credits under a protocol.
A protocol deduction or reserve set aside to manage project reversal and permanence risk.
An API workflow that evaluates carbon, carbon units, financial proforma, and summaries for one scenario.
Stand Density Index; a forestry metric describing relative stand density.
A financial or scenario input varied in the solver to show how breakeven acreage changes.
Site Index; a forestry measure of site productivity based on expected tree height at a reference age.
A forestry measure of site productivity based on expected tree height at a reference age.
The combination of tree species and densities used in the modeled planting scenario.
A list or set of trees-per-acre values by species used by the dashboard and API.
A forestry metric describing relative stand density, shown as SDI in model outputs.
API output records summarizing total net revenue, NPV, NPV per acre, and related results by protocol.
The assumed percentage of planted seedlings that survive and contribute to modeled growth.
Total cubic volume predicted by FVS-based outputs.
Total tree volume predicted by FVS-based outputs, shown as TCuFt in some charts.
Gross carbon revenue minus modeled project costs over the project period.
Display mode that scales eligible per-acre values by net project acres.
Trees per acre; a measure of planting or stand density.
A protocol adjustment or deduction representing uncertainty in carbon quantification.
Cost associated with third-party project validation.
Cost associated with third-party verification of project performance or credits.
A carbon standard and registry represented as VERRA or VCS in dashboard protocol selections.
Verra/VCS; one of the carbon accounting protocols supported by the dashboard.
Verified Carbon Standard, associated with Verra.
